items.title: Holidays & Tours
items.description: Extraordinary places. An itinerary that feels entirely like you.
items.details: From a quiet escape to a multi-city holiday, we curate your itinerary, stays, transfers and experiences around your pace and preferences.

highlights.title: A journey shaped around you
highlights.description: Share how you like to travel. We shape the route, pace and experiences around your dates and companions.

highlights.title: Stays, transfers and tickets
highlights.description: Accommodation, flights and ground travel are coordinated together, so each day connects without you chasing vendors.

highlights.title: Local experiences, quietly arranged
highlights.description: Temple visits, private boats, dining and celebrations can be woven in once we understand what matters to you.

process: Tell us your destinations, dates, group and the kind of holiday you want.
We propose a route, stay style and daily rhythm for you to refine.
Your written quote itemises the agreed arrangements before you book.
needed: Preferred destinations or a starting city
Travel dates, or a flexible window
Number of guests and any accessibility needs
The mood: restful, celebratory, pilgrimage-led or mixed
items.notes: An inquiry is not a confirmed booking. Availability, inclusions and pricing are confirmed in writing for your dates.

items.title: Visa Services
items.description: Thoughtful guidance, from paperwork to departure.
items.details: Get destination-specific document guidance and application coordination. Visa approval and processing times are determined by the relevant embassy or consulate.

highlights.title: Destination-specific checklists
highlights.description: We outline the documents, photographs and forms typically required for your nationality and destination.

highlights.title: Application coordination
highlights.description: We help you assemble the file, review completeness and guide you through submission or appointment steps.

highlights.title: Travel dates kept in view
highlights.description: Visa work is planned alongside your itinerary so appointments and validity windows stay aligned with your journey.

process: Share your nationality, destination, travel dates and passport details at a high level.
We provide a document checklist and the current application path for that embassy or consulate.
You submit the application; we stay available for follow-up questions and next steps.
needed: Passport-issuing country and current passport validity
Destination country and purpose of travel
Intended travel dates
Whether you have previous visas or refusals to mention
items.notes: Visa approval, fees and processing times are decided solely by the embassy or consulate. Irisha coordinates guidance and paperwork; we cannot guarantee an outcome.

items.title: Hotel Reservations
items.description: The right address for your kind of escape.
items.details: Share your destination, dates, room preferences and budget. We’ll help select and reserve a stay suited to your journey, with inclusions confirmed before booking.

highlights.title: Stays matched to the journey
highlights.description: Boutique, luxury and pilgrimage-friendly hotels are shortlisted for location, comfort and how you actually spend your days.

highlights.title: Inclusions confirmed first
highlights.description: Breakfast, transfers, late checkout and room type are confirmed in writing before anything is reserved.

highlights.title: One concierge for the stay
highlights.description: Your hotel sits inside the wider itinerary — arrivals, temple timings and onward travel are planned together.

process: Share destination, dates, guest count, room type and a budget range.
We shortlist suitable hotels and explain location, inclusions and conditions.
You approve a stay; we reserve it and confirm the booking details in writing.
needed: City or area and check-in / check-out dates
Number of rooms and guests
Preferred room type or accessibility needs
Budget range and any must-haves (river view, walkable to the ghats, quiet nights)
items.notes: Rates and availability change. A reservation is confirmed only after you approve the written inclusions, cancellation terms and total.

items.title: Flight Bookings
items.details: We help coordinate flight options with your itinerary, including preferred timings and connections. Fares, baggage and change conditions are confirmed before ticketing.

highlights.title: Timings that serve the itinerary
highlights.description: Arrival and departure windows are chosen around temple slots, hotel check-in and intercity transfers — not the other way around.

highlights.title: Group and family coordination
highlights.description: Seats, connections and baggage needs can be aligned for couples, families and larger travelling parties.

highlights.title: Conditions before you ticket
highlights.description: Fares, baggage allowance and change or cancellation rules are shown clearly before any ticket is issued.

process: Share origin, destination, dates, cabin preference and passenger count.
We present workable flight options against your ground itinerary.
You approve an option; we ticket and share the confirmed itinerary.
needed: Departure and arrival cities
Preferred dates or a flexible window
Number of passengers and cabin preference
Names as they appear on government ID, once you are ready to ticket
items.notes: Airfares change until ticketed. Baggage, changes and refunds follow the airline’s rules, which we confirm before you pay.

items.title: Events & Live Music
items.details: From intimate celebrations to live music experiences, tell us your occasion, location, guest count and mood. We’ll shape the arrangements around your vision.

highlights.title: Occasion-led planning
highlights.description: Birthdays, family gatherings, private recitals and travel celebrations are shaped around the people in the room.

highlights.title: Venue, music and hospitality
highlights.description: We coordinate the space, artists or playlist, dining and guest flow so the evening feels considered, not assembled.

highlights.title: Travel and stay, if you need them
highlights.description: Outstation guests can have hotels and transfers arranged as part of the same conversation.

process: Tell us the occasion, city, date, guest count and the feeling you want.
We propose a venue style, music approach and hospitality plan.
You refine the details; we confirm vendors and a written scope before the event.
needed: Occasion and preferred date or season
City or setting
Approximate guest count
Whether you also need stays, transfers or a wider holiday around the event
items.notes: Artist, venue and catering availability are confirmed only after you approve the written scope. An inquiry is not a booking.
